src: Care must be taken to rule out false positives that could masquerade as planet candidates. A giant star (HIP 16068/TIC 279741377; [[MATH_107]] = 3.15[[MATH_108]] [[MATH_109]]) is present 22'' from HD 21749. The excellent period match between the transits and the HD 21749 RVs rule out this neighboring star as the source of the TOI 186.01 transit signals. Both planet candidates on HD 21749 also pass the false positive tests performed on the {\it TESS } photometry: there is no evidence of secondary eclipses or differences between the transit depths of particular planet candidates, nor any detectable motion of the centroid of the star on the detector during the transit events.
zh: 必须谨慎行事，以排除可能伪装成行星候选体的假阳性。一颗巨星（HIP 16068/TIC 279741377；[[MATH_107]] = 3.15[[MATH_108]] [[MATH_109]]）位于 HD 21749 附近 22'' 处。凌星与 HD 21749 的径向速度之间极佳的周期匹配排除了这颗邻星作为 TOI 186.01 凌星信号的来源。HD 21749 上的两颗行星候选体也通过了在 {\it TESS } 测光数据上进行的假阳性检验：没有二次食的证据，也没有特定行星候选体之间凌星深度的差异，且在凌星事件期间没有探测到恒星在探测器上光心位置的可检测移动。

src: Stellar Activity
zh: 恒星活动

src: The future of exoplanet science is bright, as {\it TESS } once again demonstrates with the discovery of its longest-period confirmed planet yet, located only 16 pc away. We hereby present HD 21749b (TOI 186.01), a sub-Neptune in a 36-day orbit around a bright (V = 8.1), nearby K4.5 dwarf. {\it TESS } measures HD21749b to be 2.84[[MATH_50]] [[MATH_51]], and combined archival and follow-up precision radial velocity data put the mass of the planet at [[MATH_52]] [[MATH_53]]. HD 21749b is the longest-period TESS planet confirmed to date, and contributes to the {\it TESS } Level 1 Science Requirement of providing 50 transiting planets smaller than 4 [[MATH_55]] with measured masses. Furthermore, we report the discovery of TOI 186.02, a planet candidate with a 7.8-day period which, if confirmed, could become the first Earth-sized planet discovered by {\it TESS }. The HD21749 system is thus a prime candidate for comparative studies of planetary composition and architecture in multi-planet systems.
zh: 系外行星科学的前景一片光明，{\it TESS } 再次证明了这一点：其发现了迄今已确认周期最长的行星，而该行星仅距我们 16 pc。我们在此介绍 HD 21749b（TOI 186.01），它是一颗亚海王星，围绕一颗明亮（V = 8.1）且邻近的 K4.5 矮星运行，轨道周期为 36 天。{\it TESS } 测得 HD21749b 的半径为 2.84[[MATH_50]] [[MATH_51]]；结合档案数据与后续高精度视向速度数据，得到该行星的质量为 [[MATH_52]] [[MATH_53]]。HD 21749b 是迄今已确认的周期最长的 TESS 行星，并有助于实现 {\it TESS } Level 1 Science Requirement，即提供 50 颗已测得质量且小于 4 [[MATH_55]] 的凌星行星。此外，我们报告了 TOI 186.02 的发现；它是一颗周期为 7.8 天的行星候选体，若得到确认，可能成为 {\it TESS } 发现的第一颗地球大小的行星。因此，HD21749 系统是比较研究多行星系统中行星组成与系统构型的理想对象。

src: We used the 2-minute target pixel data for our analysis. The target is on the edge of the camera, where the point spread function is triangular in shape. After identifying the two transits, we tried improving the light curve precision by extracting light curves from the publicly available target pixel stamps using different photometric apertures (circles as well as irregular pixel boundaries). We then high-pass-filtered the raw light curve by fiting a basis spline with knots spaced by 0.3 days, after excluding both 3[[MATH_105]] outliers and data obtained during and immediately surrounding transits [[CITE_106]]. The final 2-minute cadence light curve has an RMS of 240 ppm.
zh: 我们在分析中使用了 2 分钟目标像素数据。目标位于相机边缘，那里的点扩散函数呈三角形。在识别出两次凌星后，我们尝试通过使用不同的测光孔径（圆形以及不规则像素边界）从公开可用的目标像素图像中提取光变曲线来提高光变曲线的精度。随后，我们对原始光变曲线进行高通滤波，通过拟合一个节点间距为 0.3 天的 B样条，此前已排除了 3[[MATH_105]] 离群值以及凌星期间及紧邻凌星前后获得的数据 [[CITE_106]]。最终的 2 分钟步长光变曲线的 RMS 为 240 ppm。

src: Relative RV measurements and best-fit models for HD 21749. {\it Top:} Complete time series including HARPS pre-upgrade (dark blue open circles), HARPS post-upgrade (dark blue points), PFS pre-upgrade (cyan open circles), and PFS post-upgrade (cyan points) data. The error bars are the quadrature sum of the instrument jitter terms and the measurement uncertainties for all RVs. The best-fit constant offsets have been subtracted, and the gray line shows the best-fit 2-planet RV model. {\it Bottom:} Phase-folded radial velocities using periods of 35.61 days for planet b (left) and 7.788 days for planet c (right), with residuals shown below. Point colors are as in the top panel, with the addition of red open circles showing the average velocities binned in 0.073 intervals of orbital phase. Each planet's best-fit model is shown with a gray line, with the Keplerian orbital model for the other planet and the long term trend subtracted.
zh: HD 21749 的相对视向速度（RV）测量与最佳拟合模型。{\it 顶部：} 包含 HARPS 升级前（深蓝色空心圆）、HARPS 升级后（深蓝色圆点）、PFS 升级前（青色空心圆）和 PFS 升级后（青色圆点）数据的完整时间序列。所有 RV 的误差棒为仪器抖动项与测量不确定度的平方和。已减去最佳拟合的常数偏移，灰色线表示最佳拟合的双行星 RV 模型。{\it 底部：} 使用行星 b（左）35.61 天和行星 c（右）7.788 天的周期进行相位折叠的径向速度，残差显示在下方。点的颜色与顶部面板一致，另增加红色空心圆，表示按 0.073 个轨道相位间隔分箱后的平均速度。每颗行星的最佳拟合模型以灰色线表示，绘制时已减去另一颗行星的开普勒轨道模型和长期趋势。

src: Feature importance is at the heart of many interpretable machine learning methods and frameworks, but the term ``importance'' encompasses several fundamentally different notions of relevance. We develop a unified perspective based on \emph{null importance}: a population-level characterization of when a feature is irrelevant under a specified notion of relevance. We consider standard notions of null importance arising from marginal and conditional statistical relevance, predictive risk, functional invariance, and causal effects, and show how these notions answer different scientific questions. We illustrate the framework through two applications in which the distinction is particularly consequential: algorithmic fairness, where common fairness criteria correspond to different notions of null importance, and genomic perturbation modeling, where different standard choices of relevance lead to different conclusions about what a prediction model has learned. The framework connects three aspects of feature analysis: the scientific question defining relevance, the data and model assumptions that shape how the different null notions relate, and the methods used to assess importance. We establish sufficient conditions under which standard notions of null importance coincide and give counterexamples showing how they diverge when those conditions fail. We then ask which notions of null different families of methods actually target and analyze the conditions under which their zero-importance statistics can identify their targets. Finally, simulations encompassing feature dependence, redundancy, nonlinearity, hidden features and other standard phenomena as well as real-data case studies on attribution in images and multiomics data provide empirical evidence for these theoretical distinctions and their practical consequences for interpreting feature importance methods. Taken together, these results provide a common statistical language for relating scientific questions, data-generating assumptions, and algorithms. This language makes precise the conclusions about feature relevance that a given feature analysis method can legitimately support.
zh: 特征重要性是许多可解释机器学习方法与框架的核心，但“重要性”一词包含若干根本不同的相关性概念。我们提出一种基于 \emph{零重要性} 的统一视角：在某一指定的相关性定义下，对特征何时不相关进行总体层面的刻画。我们考虑源于边际与条件统计相关性、预测风险、函数不变性和因果效应的标准零重要性概念，并说明这些概念如何回应不同的科学问题。我们通过两个应用示例说明该框架，在这些应用中上述区分尤为关键：算法公平性，其中常见的公平性准则对应不同的零重要性概念；以及基因组扰动建模，其中不同的标准相关性选择会导致对预测模型所学内容得出不同结论。该框架将特征分析的三个方面联系起来：定义相关性的科学问题、影响不同零重要性概念之间关系的数据与模型假设，以及用于评估重要性的方法。我们建立了标准零重要性概念彼此一致的充分条件，并给出反例，说明当这些条件不成立时它们如何分歧。接着，我们追问不同方法族实际针对的是哪一类零重要性概念，并分析其零重要性统计量在何种条件下能够识别这些目标。最后，涵盖特征依赖性、冗余、非线性、隐藏特征及其他常见现象的模拟，以及图像特征归因和多组学数据方面的真实数据案例研究，为这些理论区分及其在解释特征重要性方法上的实际后果提供了经验证据。综上所述，这些结果提供了一种共同的统计语言，用于关联科学问题、数据生成假设与算法；这种语言能够明确某一特征分析方法可以合理支持的关于特征相关性的结论。

src: Importantly, this is an \emph{identification} issue rather than a claim that cancellation is common in applications. The causal Shapley literature of [[CITE_519]] and [[CITE_520]] establishes the interventional construction and its causal interpretation, but does not, to our knowledge, provide a general no-cancellation condition or establish that cancellation is empirically frequent.
zh: 重要的是，这是一个 \emph{识别} 问题，而不是声称抵消在应用中很常见。[[CITE_519]] 和 [[CITE_520]] 的因果 Shapley 文献建立了干预构造及其因果解释，但据我们所知，并未提供一般的无抵消条件，也没有确立抵消在经验上是频繁的。

src: Figure~[[REF_439]] shows that the reasoning-effort setting gives smooth, well-behaved control over both output length and accuracy, consistently across all eight benchmarks, which span competition mathematics, science QA, open-domain knowledge and code. On the length side, raising the effort from 25 to 100 scales the average response predictably on every benchmark -- a uniform [[MATH_440]]--[[MATH_441]] increase, from 4.6k to 11.4k tokens per response on AIME 2026 and from 29.1k to 86.1k on MathArena Apex 2025 -- with no runaway growth or anomalies, so the compute cost of any tier can be estimated in advance. Accuracy follows the same smooth trajectory and responds in the right direction on every benchmark, with no benchmark ever degrading as the effort increases: MathArena Apex 2025 gains [[MATH_442]] points (25.3\%[[MATH_443]]65.6\%) and Apex 2025 Shortlist [[MATH_444]], while even the already-saturated benchmarks remain stable (GPQA Diamond [[MATH_445]], LiveCodeBench [[MATH_446]]), and AIME 2026 reaches a full 100\%. The model thus exposes a single, reliable knob that moves the cost--accuracy operating point in a controlled and predictable way, allowing each deployment to select the effort tier that matches its latency and compute budget without sacrificing accuracy.
zh: 图~[[REF_439]] 显示，推理努力设置能够平滑且表现良好地控制输出长度和准确率，在所有八个基准测试中均如此，这些基准涵盖竞赛数学、科学问答、开放域知识和代码。在长度方面，将努力程度从 25 提高到 100，可在每个基准上可预测地缩放平均响应——实现了统一的 [[MATH_440]]--[[MATH_441]] 增长，在 AIME 2026 上每次响应的 token 数从 4.6k 增加到 11.4k，在 MathArena Apex 2025 上从 29.1k 增加到 86.1k——没有失控增长或异常，因此可以提前估算任何层级的计算成本。准确率遵循同样平滑的轨迹，在每个基准上都朝着正确的方向响应，随着努力程度的提高，没有基准出现过下降：MathArena Apex 2025 提升了 [[MATH_442]] 分（25.3\%[[MATH_443]]65.6\%），Apex 2025 Shortlist [[MATH_444]]，而即使是已经饱和的基准也保持稳定（GPQA Diamond [[MATH_445]]，LiveCodeBench [[MATH_446]]），并且 AIME 2026 达到了完整的 100\%。因此，该模型提供了一个单一、可靠的旋钮，以受控且可预测的方式移动成本--准确率工作点，使每次部署都能选择与其延迟和计算预算相匹配的努力层级，而不会牺牲准确率。

src: Input mixing now uses [[MATH_136]] instead of [[MATH_137]], so it no longer depends on the coefficients computed from [[MATH_138]]. Each tile of [[MATH_139]] can therefore be used immediately for both input mixing and coefficient prediction, without waiting for the full reduction. Empirically, this shift incurs negligible performance degradation.
zh: 输入混合现在使用 [[MATH_136]] 而不是 [[MATH_137]]，因此它不再依赖于从 [[MATH_138]] 计算出的系数。因此，[[MATH_139]] 的每个块都可以立即用于输入混合和系数预测，而无需等待完整的归约。实验上，这一转变导致了可忽略的性能下降。

src:
\textbf{Three operating modes of CSA2.}
The modes differ in how they obtain main KV, indexer K, and Top-K indices. Green blocks indicate quantities computed in the current layer; yellow blocks indicate main KV and indexer K reused from the most recent Full Mode layer; while red blocks indicate Top-K indices reused from the most recent index-producing (Full or Reindex Mode) layer. All three modes compute main Q and SWA KV in the current layer.
zh:
\textbf{CSA2 的三种运行模式。}
这些模式在获取主 KV、索引器 K 和 Top-K 索引的方式上有所不同。绿色区块表示在当前层计算得到的量；黄色区块表示主 KV 和索引器 K 复用了最近一个 Full Mode 层中的结果；而红色区块表示 Top-K 索引复用了最近一个产生索引的（Full 或 Reindex Mode）层中的结果。所有三种模式都在当前层计算主 Q 和 SWA KV。
